look.plainEnglish: In plain English, Look on a timer means: A look is a question you ask on purpose. A first-person rifle asks it when the player fires or aims, and the trace starts at the camera. A third-person use asks it from IA_Interact, still from the camera, because a chest trace hits the cover the crosshair can see past. A horror hunter asks it inside Sense, on a 0.2 second timer, and a loud sound calls that same event instead of growing a second brain. A strategy team asks it inside Reveal, four times a second, and writes Visible. None of those graphs ask the question from Tick. Tick keeps asking while the player stands still, while a match is paused, and while a hunter should have forgiven a glimpse.
look.whyGame: In a real game, getting look on a timer wrong shows up as tracing from Tick, or giving a loud sound its own second brain. the Sense timer started at Begin Play is the repair, and the generated line `void UKitComponent::Graph_Sense_tpl_perception_sense() // node:tpl_perception_sense` is that repair in C++.
